# Ralph's Unblocked Games

> Official website: https://ralphsunblockedgames.vercel.app/
>
> Ralph's Unblocked Games is a browser-based directory of free online games. Visitors can browse the public game list and open individual game pages to play in a web browser. Availability of embedded games can depend on the game provider and the visitor's device or network.

## Main features

- Browse a public directory of browser games from the homepage.
- Open individual game pages, with fullscreen controls on supported games.
- Optional account features include favorites, likes, and playtime tracking.
- Read about the website and its maintainer.

## Game styles represented

The current library includes arcade, action, puzzle, sports, racing, platform, simulation, and casual games. These are descriptive groupings, not separate category pages or filters.

- [Cookie Clicker](https://ralphsunblockedgames.vercel.app/games/cookieclicker.html)
- [Chess](https://ralphsunblockedgames.vercel.app/games/Chess.html)
- [Run 3](https://ralphsunblockedgames.vercel.app/games/Run3.html)
- [Complete public-page sitemap](https://ralphsunblockedgames.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

Visitors can use the homepage to explore the complete current game directory. The sitemap lists the public HTML pages, including game pages.

## Notes

This file follows the emerging `llms.txt` convention. AI services may or may not consume it; it does not guarantee crawling, indexing, or recommendations. The game directory is maintained as static site pages. Supabase is used for account-related features such as favorites and likes, not as the public game catalog.
